held.name: npm's bundled dependencies (release job)
held.because: they're bundled inside npm, so they can't be updated alone; their alerts are dismissed as tolerable risk.
held.takeWhen: Dependabot proposes the newer npm (it does on its own); check its alerts close.

monthly: Run the live tests against the real targets (`npx vitest run -c vitest.live.config.ts test/live/<file>`): the providers change without notice.

overrides.why: Better Auth 1.7 pins 0.4.2; the override keeps one copy in the tree. Remove when the install no longer needs it.
